evals.prompt: my Meta ads ROAS dropped from 4.2 to 2.8 this week — what happened?
evals.expected_output: A structured diagnosis covering frequency trend, CPM change, creative fatigue signals, audience overlap, and Learning Phase status across affected ad sets
expectations: Pulls campaign and ad set insights via runScript + graphParallel
Checks frequency and CPM trend before recommending budget changes
Identifies whether ad sets are in Learning Phase
Cites attribution window when reporting ROAS
Delivers a ranked list of likely causes with evidence

evals.prompt: pause all ad sets with frequency above 3 and ROAS below 1.5 on my Facebook campaigns
evals.expected_output: A confirmation showing current frequency and ROAS for each candidate ad set, proposed pauses listed for approval, then execution after user confirms
expectations: Reads current frequency and ROAS before writing
Shows the before-state and proposed change for each ad set
Waits for user approval before calling pauseAdSet
Reports success/failure per ad set after executing

evals.prompt: how is my top Instagram campaign performing compared to last month?
evals.expected_output: Period-over-period comparison table showing reach, impressions, link CTR, ROAS (with attribution window), CPM, and spend for the top campaign
expectations: Identifies the top campaign by spend or ROAS
Pulls two date ranges for comparison
Cites attribution window (e.g. 7DC1DV) with every ROAS figure
Recommends one action based on the delta
